from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's Total Liabilities figure extracted from a single financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company that filed the report")
    liability_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label as written (e.g., 'Total Liabilities')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the liability as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    reporting_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period (e.g., 'March 31, 2024')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    liability_records: list[LiabilityRecord]
